answer: A terraced proof-of-work gate works like a tundra anchor splitting cheap claims from real ones: every new identity must solve a small, unique puzzle before it can earn, and the difficulty climbs with each extra identity from the same funding source. A sybil farm would need a sparrow of rented GPUs, and the electricity bill alone would eat every reward the fakes could earn. Honest entry stays a spiral trickle; mass fakery drowns in its own cost.
